title: VioLA: Learning Generalist Humanoid Control Policies from Human Data
summary: Teaching a humanoid to follow instructions with its whole body runs into two obstacles. Its action space is large and tightly coupled: legs, arms, and fingers must move together while the robot keeps its balance, which makes joint-level actions hard to learn. And humanoid demonstrations are scarce, so current humanoid generalist policies do not follow new instructions out of the box and are fine-tuned on teleoperated demonstrations of each task before deployment. Human demonstrations exist in far larger numbers, but a person's motion is not a robot command. We remove both obstacles by changing what the generalist policy predicts. We introduce VioLA, a generalist humanoid policy that predicts body and hand motion latents instead of joint commands. A pretrained body- and hand-controller execute these latents on the robot. Their corresponding motion encoders map human and robot motion into the same latent spaces. A human recording is therefore labeled in the policy's action space, and the training demonstration pool contains 140.6 million frames, 93.2% of them human. As a result, VioLA follows locomotion instructions on the real robot zero-shot, without task-specific fine-tuning, reaching 100% success where GR00T N1.7 and $Ψ_0$ reach 16.7% and 0%, respectively. It also reaches 88.6% manipulation success without task-specific fine-tuning. The same approach works across two VLA and one world-action model backbones. A generalist policy trained on human demonstrations alone performs locomotion tasks on the real robot zero-shot. Code and checkpoints will be released.
tldr: VioLA trains a generalist humanoid policy to predict body and hand motion latents instead of joint commands, enabling zero-shot instruction following on a real robot by leveraging 140.6M frames of mostly human demonstrations. It achieves 100% locomotion and 88.6% manipulation success without task-specific fine-tuning, outperforming existing models like GR00T N1.7.
tldr_zh: VioLA 通过让通用人形机器人策略预测身体和手部运动潜在表示而非关节指令，利用1.406亿帧（其中93.2%为人类数据）的演示数据，实现了在真实机器人上的零样本指令跟随，运动成功率达100%，操作成功率达88.6%，无需任务特定微调。
summary_zh: 教授人形机器人用全身执行指令面临两大障碍。其动作空间庞大且高度耦合：腿部、手臂和手指必须协同运动，同时机器人需保持平衡，这使得关节级动作难以学习。此外，人形机器人演示数据稀缺，因此现有的通用人形机器人策略无法开箱即用地执行新指令，而是在部署前需针对每项任务在遥操作演示数据上进行微调。人类演示数据数量远为庞大，但人体动作并非机器人指令。我们通过改变通用策略的预测对象来同时消除这两大障碍。我们提出VioLA，一种通用人形机器人策略，它预测身体和手部动作的潜在表征而非关节指令。预训练的身体和手部控制器在机器人上执行这些潜在表征。相应的动作编码器将人类动作和机器人动作映射到相同的潜在空间中。因此，人类录制的数据可直接在策略的动作空间中进行标注，训练演示池包含1.406亿帧，其中93.2%为人类数据。由此，VioLA在真实机器人上零样本地执行移动指令，无需任务特定的微调，成功率可达100%，而GR00T N1.7和Ψ₀的成功率分别为16.7%和0%。它在无需任务特定微调的情况下，操纵任务成功率也达到88.6%。该方案在两种VLA骨干网络和一种世界动作模型骨干网络上均有效。仅使用人类演示数据训练的通用策略即可在真实机器人上零样本地执行移动任务。代码和检查点将公开发布。

title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
summary: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/
tldr: ARC introduces a reasoning recipe—comprising a reasoning trace, automatic labeling, and adaptation strategy—that significantly boosts zero-shot performance of existing robot foundation models without extra data or massive training. It improves state-of-the-art VLAs and WAMs on benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: ARC提出了一种推理配方，包括推理轨迹、自动标注和适应策略，在不增加数据或大规模训练的情况下显著提升现有机器人基础模型的零样本性能，并在基准测试和真实机器人上取得领先成果。
summary_zh: 提升机器人基础模型（RFM）的主流方法依赖于更大的模型、更多的机器人演示数据以及大规模的高成本训练。我们表明，存在一种有效且高效的补充途径：恰当的推理方案能够显著提升现有最先进RFM的零样本任务性能。我们将该方案称为ARC。它包含三个关键要素：推理轨迹、可扩展的自动标注流程，以及使预训练RFM利用这些轨迹进行控制的适配策略。首先，我们发现有效的推理轨迹应基于机器人的下一个动作，并解释其因果结构：该动作为何恰当，以及应产生何种效果。其次，我们证明这些轨迹可以从现有演示中自动生成，从而无需采集新的机器人数据即可从DROID构建ARC-Trace-DROID。第三，我们展示了最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），如$π_{0.5}$，以及世界动作模型（WAM），如Cosmos3-Nano-Policy，如何通过针对各模型架构和能力量身定制的微调与推理方式，学习利用这些轨迹进行控制。利用ARC，我们在零样本RFM性能上取得了迄今未见过的提升，且无需额外的机器人演示或基础模型规模的训练。适配后的模型在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上确立了新的最先进水平，在RoboLab-Reasoning-50上的性能提升最高达50个百分点。在真实机器人上，ARC将$π_{0.5}$的任务成功率提升了82.2个百分点。项目网站：https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

title: LiteNWM: Efficient Latent World Models for Onboard Visual Navigation in the Wild
summary: Direct visual navigation policies generate trajectories efficiently but do not explicitly evaluate their future consequences. Generative navigation world models provide this foresight through visual rollouts, which are costly when evaluating multiple candidates. We present LiteNWM, a latent navigation world model that shares visual encoding across candidates and jointly predicts their action-conditioned future representations at multiple horizons, while a learned scorer uses these predictions to select trajectories. In offline evaluations on RECON, SCAND, and SACSoN, LiteNWM reduces macro-averaged trajectory error by 17.56% relative to NoMaD+NWM-XL and achieves a 128.00-fold end-to-end speedup on an RTX 5090. The same evaluator transfers from NoMaD to MBRA without proposer-specific retraining, reducing MBRA's macro-averaged trajectory error by 16.2%. In real-robot experiments in unseen indoor and outdoor environments, LiteNWM improves navigation success from 43.3% to 83.3% relative to NoMaD. These results demonstrate that LiteNWM can be deployed for future-aware planning and closed-loop navigation on a physical robot.
tldr: LiteNWM introduces a latent navigation world model that shares visual encoding across candidate trajectories and jointly predicts future representations, enabling efficient future-aware planning and closed-loop navigation on real robots.
tldr_zh: LiteNWM 提出了一种共享视觉编码的潜在导航世界模型，通过联合预测多个候选轨迹的未来表征，实现了高效的前瞻规划和真实机器人闭环导航。
summary_zh: 直接视觉导航策略能够高效生成轨迹，但并未显式评估其未来后果。生成式导航世界模型通过视觉推演提供了这种前瞻能力，但在评估多个候选方案时成本高昂。我们提出了LiteNWM，一种潜空间导航世界模型，它在候选方案之间共享视觉编码，并联合预测其在多个时间尺度上的动作条件未来表征，同时一个学习得到的评分器利用这些预测来选择轨迹。在RECON、SCAND和SACSoN上的离线评估中，LiteNWM相较于NoMaD+NWM-XL将宏平均轨迹误差降低了17.56%，并在RTX 5090上实现了128.00倍的端到端加速。同一评估器无需针对提议器进行重新训练即可从NoMaD迁移至MBRA，使MBRA的宏平均轨迹误差降低了16.2%。在未见过的室内和室外环境中的真实机器人实验中，LiteNWM相对于NoMaD将导航成功率从43.3%提升至83.3%。这些结果表明，LiteNWM可部署于物理机器人上的未来感知规划与闭环导航。

title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
summary: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce UNITAS, to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, UNITAS achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS.
tldr: UNITAS is a 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in metric 3D space, achieving state-of-the-art manipulation and action-conditioned scene prediction.
tldr_zh: UNITAS 是一个3D原生的世界动作模型，在度量3D空间中统一了观察、动作和场景动态，在操作和动作条件下的场景预测方面达到了最先进水平。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）旨在回答一个耦合物理问题：给定任务指令，机器人应执行何种动作，以及该动作将如何改变周围世界？现有的大多数WAMs基于预训练的视频生成器构建，并通过图像或视觉潜在特征来表示世界演化。然而，机器人交互发生在度量三维空间中，而图像是依赖于视角的投影，其像素距离并不直接编码物理距离。我们提出了UNITAS，据我们所知，这是首个三维原生的世界动作模型，它在每次交互中统一观测、动作和场景动态于共享的度量3D框架内，并在不同机器人本体和人手之间使用统一的表示。动作流将人手和机器人夹爪表示为3D点轨迹，而场景流则描述在这些轨迹条件下的场景点位移。世界对齐的3D位置嵌入在有或无深度输入的情况下对视觉令牌进行接地，物理时间轨迹分词器将每条点轨迹编码为一个锚定在其当前3D位置的令牌。该接口支持直接动作执行和动作条件化的场景预测。凭借17亿参数，UNITAS在RoboTwin上实现了所比较方法中最佳的动作条件化场景预测，位移误差较PointWorld最高降低49%，并达到了最先进的操控成功率，包括在LIBERO上达到99.8%，在真实世界任务中平均达到85%。代码可在 https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS 获取。

title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.
tldr: HWAM enhances humanoid VLA policies by jointly generating reference actions and post-execution body states, reducing the action-execution gap and improving real-robot task success.
tldr_zh: HWAM 通过联合生成参考动作和执行后身体状态，缩小动作-执行差距，提升真实人形机器人任务成功率。
summary_zh: 人形机器人是一种极具前景的通用操作平台。近年来的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略直接从多模态观测中学习动作，而世界动作模型（WAMs）则进一步引入未来视觉预测以提升动作生成质量。然而，在分层式人形机器人系统中，VLA和WAM策略输出的参考动作需通过全身控制、机器人动力学、平衡与接触控制来最终实现。这种层级结构导致了动作-执行间隙：策略生成的参考动作与机器人实际执行的运动之间可能存在差异。若未显式建模实际执行的机体状态，未来视觉预测就必须同时解释场景演化以及参考动作与执行运动之间的偏差，从而使动作与其物理结果之间的关联变得困难。为此，我们提出HWAM——一种具备关节状态-动作联合生成能力的人形机器人世界动作模型，将机器人执行后的本体感知状态作为显式预测目标。通过联合生成参考动作及其实际执行的机体状态，HWAM直接将执行运动的监督信息融入动作学习过程。HWAM通过三条互补的条件路径进行训练。策略路径仅以当前观测为条件，联合去噪状态-动作轨迹，与部署条件保持一致。前向动力学建模（FDM）以动作和执行后状态为条件预测未来视觉观测，而逆动力学建模（IDM）则从视觉状态转换中重建关节轨迹。这些路径共同将策略参考、实际机体运动与视觉结果联系在一起。在LimX OLI人形机器人的三项真实机器人任务中，HWAM在所有评估基线中取得了最高的成功率。在糖果拾取任务中，HWAM的成功率达到70.6%，而Fast-WAM仅为43.3%。

title: CAPABLE: Capability-Aware Policy Adaptation via Behavioral Latent Encoding
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies assume the embodiment on which they were trained and can fail when a joint fault changes how commanded actions are physically executed. Existing fault-recovery methods often require task-specific retraining, fault labels, explicit diagnosis, or privileged embodiment information. We introduce CAPABLE, a unified capability-aware adaptation framework for frozen VLAs that integrates self-supervised capability inference with residual reinforcement learning. CAPABLE infers capability, how much of the commanded motion each joint actually realizes and how that motion contributes to end-effector behavior, online from command-response history and kinematics using a temporal encoder shared across joints, Jacobian grounding, cross-joint attention, and self-supervised physical prediction. The resulting representation conditions a residual policy that adds bounded corrections to the VLA arm action without fault labels or faulty-joint identifiers. Across 28 LIBERO tasks, CAPABLE raises success on an actuator excluded from fault training from 24.8% to 59.3%, outperforming a parameter-matched global-history baseline by 17.4 points while preserving healthy performance. Leave-one-actuator-out experiments across six joints show that this transfer is not specific to one actuator, and additional evaluations characterize transfer to unseen fault families and demonstrate recovery on a physical Franka Panda. https://capable-vla.github.io/
tldr: CAPABLE introduces a capability-aware adaptation framework for frozen VLA policies, using self-supervised capability inference and residual reinforcement learning to recover from joint faults without labels, improving success rates on LIBERO benchmarks and showing real-robot transfer.
tldr_zh: CAPABLE提出了一种针对冻结VLA策略的能力感知自适应框架，通过自监督能力推断和残差强化学习，无需标签即可从关节故障中恢复，在LIBERO基准上提升了成功率，并展示了真实机器人迁移。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略假定其训练时所依托的具体本体，当关节故障改变指令动作的物理执行方式时，这类策略可能失效。现有的故障恢复方法通常需要针对特定任务重新训练、故障标签、显式诊断或特权本体信息。我们提出CAPABLE，一种面向冻结VLA的统一能力感知自适应框架，将自监督能力推断与残差强化学习相结合。CAPABLE通过跨关节共享的时间编码器、雅可比矩阵 grounding、跨关节注意力以及自监督物理预测，在线地从指令-响应历史与运动学信息中推断能力——即每个关节实际实现指令运动的比例，以及该运动对末端执行器行为的贡献程度。由此得到的表示对残差策略进行条件约束，该策略在不依赖故障标签或故障关节标识符的情况下，向VLA手臂动作添加有界修正。在28个LIBERO任务中，CAPABLE将未参与故障训练的执行器成功率从24.8%提升至59.3%，比参数匹配的全局历史基线高出17.4个百分点，同时保持健康状态下的性能不受影响。跨六个关节的留一执行器实验表明，这种迁移并非针对某一特定执行器，额外评估进一步刻画了对未见故障族的迁移能力，并在实体Franka Panda上验证了恢复效果。https://capable-vla.github.io/

title: Tell Robot What Not to Do: A Negation Understanding Perspective
summary: Instruction following enables robots to perform diverse tasks specified in natural language, making it a fundamental capability for human-robot interaction. Beyond communicating desired outcomes, users also need to specify constraints on what not to do. We investigate how to enable vision-language-action models (VLAs) to follow negated instructions, where robots must accomplish task goals while respecting explicit exclusions. To this end, we propose NegaAlign, a parameter-efficient, plug-and-play framework that extends pretrained VLAs to follow negated instructions through image-language supervision alone. Specifically, we introduce Negation Transformation Layers into selected layers of the vision-language backbone to reshape intermediate instruction representations. Meanwhile, a teacher-guided alignment mechanism is designed to align instruction-relevant visual tokens, transferring action-relevant grounding from instructions that satisfy the negated constraint. The training phase uses supervision constructed from existing demonstrations and updates only the inserted layers, keeping all pretrained parameters frozen, including the action generator. We further introduce NegaBench, a simulation benchmark spanning 10 scenarios across five domains for systematically evaluating manipulation under negated constraints. Experiments across GR00T, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements in negated instruction following. With 11.6M trainable parameters, NegaAlign increases the negated-instruction success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 2.60% to 88.45% on NegaBench and from 12.4% to 88.8% on real-world tasks, while retaining performance on affirmative instructions.
tldr: This paper presents NegaAlign, a parameter-efficient framework that extends vision-language-action models (VLAs) to follow negated instructions by inserting novel Negation Transformation Layers and using a teacher-guided alignment mechanism, demonstrating significant improvements in success rates on simulation and real-world tasks while retaining performance on affirmative instructions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出NegaAlign，一种参数高效的框架，通过插入否定变换层和教师引导的对齐机制，扩展视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）以遵循否定指令，在仿真和真实任务中显著提高了成功率，同时保持对肯定指令的性能。
summary_zh: 指令跟随使机器人能够执行自然语言所指定的多样化任务，因此成为人机交互中的一项基础能力。除了传达期望的结果外，用户还需要对不可执行的内容加以约束。我们研究了如何使视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）能够遵循否定指令，即机器人在完成目标任务的同时，必须遵守明确的排除条件。为此，我们提出了NegaAlign，一种参数高效、即插即用的框架，仅通过图像-语言监督即可将预训练的VLA扩展为能够遵循否定指令的模型。具体而言，我们在视觉-语言骨干网络的选定层中引入否定变换层，以重塑中间指令表示。同时，设计了一种教师引导的对齐机制，用于对齐与指令相关的视觉令牌，从而将满足否定约束的指令中的动作相关信息传递至实际执行。训练阶段利用现有示范构建监督信号，仅更新插入的层，所有预训练参数（包括动作生成器）均保持冻结。我们还进一步引入了NegaBench，一个覆盖五个领域共十个场景的模拟基准，用于在否定约束下系统性地评估操作能力。在GR00T、$π_0$和$π_{0.5}$上的实验表明，否定指令跟随性能均获得了一致提升。凭借1160万可训练参数，NegaAlign将$π_{0.5}$在NegaBench上的否定指令成功率从2.60%提升至88.45%，在真实世界任务中从12.4%提升至88.8%，同时保持了肯定指令任务的原有性能。

title: PathTime-VLA: Path-Time Decoupling for Factorized Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies typically predict actions at fixed time intervals, coupling the route a robot follows with its execution pace. This coupling complicates adaptation from teleoperation: useful geometric guidance comes with timing shaped by interface delays and operator behavior. Our key insight is to bring the path-time parameterization of classical motion planning into the learned action representation of a VLA. We introduce PathTime-VLA, which represents motion as a progress-indexed interaction path $X(s)$ and a positive interval-time profile. The latter defines a monotone time law $t(s)$, yielding controller commands $X(s(t))$. For a given path, alternative executions are expressed through the time profile, allowing chunk-wise speed choices without changing the geometric prediction target. This representation supports a staged post-training procedure: demonstrations and DAgger interventions establish a target-domain prior, Speed-DQN learns execution multipliers from robot interaction, and Path-AWR uses rollout outcomes to refine the diffusion path generator. A path-conditioned action expert realizes the resulting motions while maintaining distinct learning interfaces for path generation and execution timing. Across three tasks, the complete method achieves $58/60$ successes versus $57/60$ for PathTime-VLA under BC + DAgger at fixed $1\times$, with approximately $39$-$52\%$ shorter mean completion times over successful trials.
tldr: PathTime-VLA decouples path geometry from execution timing in VLA policies, enabling factorized post-training where speed profiles are learned separately from path generation. This yields faster task completion while maintaining high success rates across three real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: PathTime-VLA 将VLA策略中的路径几何与执行时序解耦，通过分离的路径生成和速度学习后训练，在保持高成功率的同时显著缩短任务完成时间。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常以固定的时间间隔预测动作，将机器人所遵循的路径与其执行节奏耦合在一起。这种耦合使得从遥操作中进行适配变得复杂：有用的几何引导伴随的是由接口延迟和操作者行为所塑造的时序。我们的关键洞察在于，将经典运动规划中的路径-时间参数化引入VLA的学习动作表示中。我们提出了PathTime-VLA，它将运动表示为一个以进度为索引的交互路径$X(s)$和一个正的时间间隔剖面。后者定义了一个单调的时间律$t(s)$，从而产生控制器指令$X(s(t))$。对于给定路径，替代执行方式通过时间剖面来表达，允许在不改变几何预测目标的情况下进行分块速度选择。这种表示支持一种分阶段的训练后流程：演示和DAgger干预建立目标域先验，Speed-DQN从机器人交互中学习执行乘数，Path-AWR利用 rollout 结果来精炼扩散路径生成器。一个路径条件化的动作专家实现最终的运动，同时在路径生成和执行时序之间保持不同的学习接口。在三个任务中，完整方法在固定$1\times$速度下的BC + DAgger设置中取得了$58/60$次成功，而PathTime-VLA为$57/60$次，且在成功试验中平均完成时间缩短了约$39$-$52\%$。

title: SDPAD: A Fully Spike-Driven Pipeline for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving demands trajectory planners that are both highly accurate and cheap enough for edge deployment. State-of-the-art artificial neural network (ANN) planners meet the accuracy requirement at the cost of heavy dense computation, while spiking neural networks (SNNs)---though promising orders-of-magnitude energy savings through sparse, event-driven arithmetic---still lag far behind in planning accuracy. We present \textbf{SDPAD}, a fully spike-driven end-to-end planning pipeline that closes this gap. SDPAD converts a pre-trained ANN perception stack into integer-spike form via quantized ANN2SNN conversion, lifts multi-view images into the bird's-eye-view (BEV) space with a spike-driven-max (SDM) depth distribution (Spike-3D-Lift), and plans through the Spike-QFormer, a spiking query transformer in which ego, agent, and map queries distilled from the BEV scene are fused by learnable waypoint queries via cross-attention, followed by deformable spike-cross-attention refinement. Every operation is gated by integer spikes and inference is a single feed-forward pass without temporal simulation loops. On the nuScenes open-loop benchmark, SDPAD achieves an average $L_2$ error of 0.40\,m and a collision rate of 0.12\%, on par with strong ANN planners while consuming 69.9\,mJ---less than 2\% of recent ANN baselines. In closed-loop evaluation on the NAVSIM navtest split, SDPAD reaches 86.3 PDMS, surpassing the previous SNN planner SAD by 4.3 points and matching mainstream ANN planners at a fraction of their energy. To our knowledge, SDPAD is the first fully spike-driven planner evaluated in end-to-end autonomous driving, demonstrating that SNNs can rival dense ANNs in complex driving tasks.
tldr: SDPAD is the first fully spike-driven end-to-end autonomous driving pipeline, using quantized ANN2SNN conversion and a spiking query transformer to achieve ANN-level planning accuracy on nuScenes and NAVSIM while consuming orders of magnitude less energy.
tldr_zh: SDPAD是首个全脉冲驱动的端到端自动驾驶规划管线，通过量化ANN2SNN转换和脉冲查询transformer，在nuScenes和NAVSIM上达到与ANN相当的性能，同时能耗降低一到两个数量级。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶对轨迹规划器提出了高精度与低成本边缘部署的双重需求。当前最先进的人工神经网络（ANN）规划器虽能满足精度要求，却依赖大量密集计算；而脉冲神经网络（SNN）——尽管凭借稀疏、事件驱动的运算有望实现数量级的能耗节省——在规划精度上仍明显落后。我们提出\textbf{SDPAD}，一个全脉冲驱动的端到端规划流水线，填补了这一差距。SDPAD通过量化ANN2SNN转换将预训练的ANN感知栈转化为整型脉冲形式，利用脉冲驱动最大值（SDM）深度分布（Spike-3D-Lift）将多视角图像提升至鸟瞰图（BEV）空间，并通过Spike-QFormer——一种脉冲查询变换器——完成规划。在该变换器中，从BEV场景中提取的自车、他车与地图查询通过学习得到的路径点查询经交叉注意力融合，再经可变形脉冲交叉注意力细化。所有运算均由整型脉冲门控，推理过程为单次前向传播，无需时间模拟循环。在nuScenes开环基准上，SDPAD实现了平均$L_2$误差0.40\,m和碰撞率0.12\%，与强ANN规划器相当，同时能耗仅为69.9\,mJ——不到近期ANN基线方法的2\%。在NAVSIM navtest分区的闭环评估中，SDPAD达到86.3 PDMS，超过此前SNN规划器SAD达4.3个百分点，并以极低的能耗匹配主流ANN规划器。据我们所知，SDPAD是首个在端到端自动驾驶中评估的全脉冲驱动规划器，证明了SNN在复杂驾驶任务中可与密集ANN相媲美。

title: Rewiring Semantics, Dynamics, and Control: A Simple yet Effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent framework for complex robotic manipulation, building on the strong semantic understanding of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, such VLM backbones offer insufficient physical dynamics priors, which limits the generalization capabilities of robot policies. Recent efforts therefore integrate video-generation World Models (WMs) into robot policies through various strategies, using predictive dynamics to facilitate action generation. Despite these advances, harnessing semantic understanding and dynamics prediction as complementary guidance for action generation remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce $\mathrm{ACT}^3$, a simple yet effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer that fuses semantic and dynamics information into control actions while preserving the distinct roles of context streams. Specifically, $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ enables the dedicated action expert to access VLM and WM representations through layerwise attention, with each backbone attending only within its own stream. This straightforward interaction design maintains independent forward propagation in the context streams while allowing both backbones to be updated through control supervision. Experiments on both simulated and real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks show that the proposed $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ yields results superior to its counterparts.
tldr: This paper proposes ACT3, a tri-stream Transformer that integrates a Vision-Language Model and a World Model into a robot manipulation policy, using an action-centric attention mechanism to fuse semantic and dynamics information while preserving each stream's distinct role.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ACT3，一种三流Transformer架构，将视觉语言模型和世界模型集成到机器人操作策略中，通过以动作为中心的注意力机制融合语义和动力学信息，同时保持各流的不同作用。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为复杂机器人操作的重要框架，其建立在预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）强大的语义理解基础之上。然而，此类VLM骨干网络缺乏足够的物理动力学先验知识，这限制了机器人策略的泛化能力。因此，近年来的研究通过多种策略将视频生成世界模型（WM）集成到机器人策略中，利用预测动力学来促进动作生成。尽管取得了这些进展，如何将语义理解和动力学预测作为互补指导来促进动作生成仍然是一个挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种简单而有效的以动作中心的三流Transformer——$\mathrm{ACT}^3$，它将语义和动力学信息融合到控制动作中，同时保持各上下文流的独立角色。具体而言，$\mathrm{ACT}^3$通过逐层注意力机制使专用的动作专家能够访问VLM和WM的表征，而每个骨干网络仅在自身流内部进行注意力计算。这种简洁的交互设计在保持上下文流独立前向传播的同时，允许两个骨干网络通过控制监督进行更新。在仿真和真实机器人操作基准上的实验表明，所提出的$\mathrm{ACT}^3$取得了优于同类方法的结果。

title: WAM-Cache: Staleness-Bounded KV Reuse for Efficient World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable generalist robot manipulation by conditioning an action expert on representations from a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). In closed-loop control, the video DiT runs at every chunk to encode the current observation into layerwise key-value (KV) pairs that the action expert queries. This prefill dominates the per-chunk computational cost, yet existing training-free accelerations leave it fully dense. We present WAM-Cache, a training-free framework that retains layerwise key-value representations across chunks and recomputes only a sparse refresh set of tokens. Crucially, we find that the intuitive heuristic of refreshing visually drifted tokens plateaus far below the dense baseline, even with an oracle predicting ground-truth KV drift. Downstream action accuracy is instead governed by where the action expert attends, not by what moved. WAM-Cache therefore selects the refresh set by uniting the action expert's cross-attention with visual latent surprise, complemented by a strict age bound that suppresses compounding error. On Fast-WAM, WAM-Cache cuts video DiT prefill FLOPs by 32-42% across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world experiments, while staying within 0.7-1.8 percentage points of the dense policy in simulation and 2.5 points on a real robot.
tldr: WAM-Cache introduces a training-free KV cache reuse strategy for World Action Models, selectively recomputing sparse tokens based on action-expert cross-attention and visual latent surprise with an age bound, cutting video DiT prefill FLOPs by 32-42% while maintaining policy accuracy in simulation and real robot experiments.
tldr_zh: WAM-Cache 提出了一种无需训练的 KV 缓存重用策略，用于世界动作模型，基于动作专家交叉注意力和视觉潜在惊喜选择稀疏令牌进行重计算，并设置严格年龄界限，在模拟和真实机器人实验中减少 32-42% 的视频 DiT 预填充 FLOPs，同时保持策略精度。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过将动作专家与预训练视频扩散变换器（DiT）的表征条件化，实现了通用机器人操作。在闭环控制中，视频DiT在每个时间块运行，将当前观测编码为逐层键值（KV）对，供动作专家查询。这一预填充过程主导了每个时间块的计算成本，然而现有的免训练加速方法使其保持完全密集计算。我们提出了WAM-Cache，一种免训练框架，跨时间块保留逐层键值表征，仅重新计算稀疏的刷新令牌集。关键在于，我们发现刷新视觉漂移令牌的直观启发式方法在性能上远低于密集基线，即使使用预言机预测真实KV漂移也是如此。下游动作精度实际上由动作专家的注意力位置决定，而非由移动的内容决定。因此，WAM-Cache通过联合动作专家的交叉注意力与视觉潜在惊喜度来选择刷新集，并辅以严格的年龄界限以抑制累积误差。在Fast-WAM上，WAM-Cache在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及真实世界实验中减少了32-42%的视频DiT预填充FLOPs，同时在仿真中保持与密集策略0.7-1.8个百分点的差距，在真实机器人上保持2.5个百分点的差距。

title: PlanWAM: Planning-Shaped Future Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: World models in end-to-end autonomous driving predict future scene evolution to provide foresight for trajectory planning. Existing methods mainly study how to predict the future and how to use it, but less often ask which future representation is actually most useful for planning. To this end, we propose PlanWAM, a Planning-Shaped World Action Model. The key idea is to let the planning task shape the future-state representation, so that it retains the information most useful for planning. A latent world model then predicts this planning-shaped future latent representation from historical observations and uses it for planning, enabling foresighted planning. Specifically, we first use a Temporal Register Pyramid to compress multi-frame historical information in a recency-aware manner, learning a compact history representation oriented toward future reasoning and planning. We then introduce a privileged future posterior branch that observes ground-truth future frames, and shape its future latent representation with trajectory-planning objectives to obtain a planning-shaped future latent representation. Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation trains a prior branch that depends only on history to predict this future latent representation. The predicted future latent representation serves as planning context and guides trajectory generation and selection. PlanWAM achieves 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest and reaches 38.7 HD-Score on closed-loop HUGSIM in a zero-shot setting, demonstrating leading planning performance across both open-loop and closed-loop evaluations. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that planning-shaped future representations provide an effective and deployable form of foresight for world-action models.
tldr: PlanWAM introduces a planning-shaped future representation for world action models in end-to-end autonomous driving, using trajectory-planning objectives to shape the predicted future latent and demonstrating strong open-loop and closed-loop performance.
tldr_zh: PlanWAM 提出了一种面向规划的未来表征，用于端到端自动驾驶的世界动作模型，通过轨迹规划目标塑造预测的未来潜变量，并在开环和闭环评估中表现出色。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶中的世界模型通过预测未来场景演化，为轨迹规划提供前瞻性信息。现有方法主要研究如何预测未来以及如何使用预测结果，但很少探讨哪种未来表示对规划而言实际上最为有效。为此，我们提出PlanWAM，一种面向规划塑造的世界动作模型（Planning-Shaped World Action Model）。其核心思想是让规划任务塑造未来状态表示，从而保留对规划最有用的信息。随后，潜在世界模型从历史观测中预测这一经规划塑造的未来潜在表示，并利用其进行规划，实现具有前瞻性的规划能力。具体而言，我们首先使用时间寄存器金字塔（Temporal Register Pyramid）以近因感知的方式压缩多帧历史信息，学习一种面向未来推理与规划的紧凑历史表示。然后，我们引入一个能够观测真实未来帧的特权未来后验分支，并通过轨迹规划目标对其未来潜在表示进行塑造，从而获得一种经规划塑造的未来潜在表示。通过“后见之明到前瞻性蒸馏”（Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation），我们训练一个仅依赖历史信息的前验分支来预测这一未来潜在表示。预测得到的未来潜在表示作为规划上下文，引导轨迹生成与轨迹选择。PlanWAM在NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest上达到93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS，并在零样本设置下的闭环HUGSIM评测中取得38.7 HD-Score，在开环与闭环两种评测中均展现出领先的规划性能。大量实验进一步表明，经规划塑造的未来表示为世界动作模型提供了一种有效且可部署的前瞻性表征形式。

title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.
tldr: Being-M0.7 is a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors from mixed-modality human data (video, motion, paired) to humanoid loco-manipulation control through three training stages, achieving strong performance in simulation and real-world Unitree G1 tasks.
tldr_zh: Being-M0.7 是一种潜在世界-动作模型，通过从混合模态人类数据（视频、动作、配对数据）中迁移视觉-运动先验到人形机器人操作控制，利用三阶段训练在仿真和真实Unitree G1任务上取得了优异性能。
summary_zh: 类人机器人 locomotion-manipulation 任务要求协调运动与操作，并依赖对未来场景演变和全身运动的预测，然而这类能力的习得受限于稀缺的机器人示范数据。人类视频与动作数据集提供了可扩展的监督信号，但其中许多仅包含视频或仅包含动作，而非配对的视频-动作数据。此外，人类动作并不能直接转化为可执行的机器人动作。我们提出 Being-M0.7，一种潜在世界-动作模型，通过预训练、机器人中期训练和动作后训练三个阶段的流程，将从混合模态人类数据中学习到的视觉-运动先验迁移至类人机器人控制。我们从超过 10,000 小时的人类中心原始数据中构建语料库，整合仅视频、仅动作以及配对视频-动作三种数据流，以学习互补的视觉动力学和全身运动学结构。对未来潜在视觉状态和动作的联合预测，促使视觉表征编码未来运动学信息。机器人中期训练将该粗粒度先验适应至机器人视角与身体动力学。在动作后训练阶段，一个动作专家模块通过门控交叉注意力机制，将冻结的适配后先验所产生的视觉预测表征与当前图像及本体感觉相融合，从而将预测上下文具体化为可执行的全身动作指令。在 SIMPLE 基准上，Being-M0.7 相较于对比基线取得了最高的综合成功率，并在真实世界 Unitree G1 的 locomotion-manipulation 任务上达到了与最强基线相当的性能。

title: SimVLA: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Learning for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Large-scale, diverse datasets have driven the success of LLMs and VLMs. But VLAs for robotics remain limited by the cost and complexity of real-world data collection. While simulation offers a scalable alternative, its potential for sim-to-real VLA learning in mobile manipulation remains largely underexplored. We introduce SimVLA, an end-to-end framework that trains VLAs entirely on synthetic simulation data without teleoperation for mobile manipulation. SimVLA is first pre-trained on two complementary simulation-derived datasets: SimAction, a large-scale robot action dataset spanning 35 diverse mobile manipulation tasks, generated by composing atomic skills, and SimVQA, which leverages privileged simulator state to provide spatial, geometric, and subtask-level visual-language supervision. We further post-train SimVLA on a mixture of SimAction and SimDeploy, a dataset collected from policy rollouts across diverse simulated environments. We evaluate SimVLA on tasks including restocking, pouring, and cleaning, and show zero-shot transfer to real-world mobile manipulation, including real home environments. SimVLA outperforms policies trained on 50 in-domain real-world demonstrations, suggesting that simulation can enable scalable sim-to-real mobile manipulation. We further demonstrate the value of multiple complementary forms of supervision for effectively leveraging simulation in VLA training.
tldr: SimVLA trains vision-language-action models entirely on synthetic simulation data without teleoperation, using two complementary datasets (SimAction and SimVQA) plus a post-training rollout dataset, and demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for mobile manipulation tasks in real home environments, outperforming policies trained on 50 real-world demonstrations.
tldr_zh: SimVLA 完全在无需遥操作的合成仿真数据上训练视觉-语言-动作模型，利用两个互补数据集（SimAction 和 SimVQA）以及后训练的 rollout 数据集，在真实家庭环境中的移动操作任务中展示了零样本仿真到现实的迁移，性能优于使用 50 个真实世界演示训练的策略。
summary_zh: 大规模、多样化的数据集推动了大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的成功，然而，面向机器人的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）仍受限于真实世界数据采集的成本与复杂度。尽管仿真提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但其在移动操作任务中实现仿真到现实迁移的VLA学习潜力尚未得到充分探索。我们提出SimVLA，一种端到端框架，完全基于合成仿真数据训练VLA，无需遥操作即可完成移动操作任务。SimVLA首先在两个互补的仿真数据集上进行预训练：SimAction，一个涵盖35种多样化移动操作任务的大规模机器人动作数据集，通过组合原子技能生成；以及SimVQA，利用特权仿真器状态提供空间、几何及子任务级别的视觉语言监督。我们进一步在SimAction与SimDeploy的混合数据上对SimVLA进行后训练，其中SimDeploy是从多样化仿真环境中的策略 rollout 采集的数据集。我们在补货、倒水和清洁等任务上评估SimVLA，并展示了其向真实世界移动操作的零样本迁移能力，包括真实家庭环境。SimVLA优于在50个领域内真实世界演示上训练的策略，表明仿真能够实现可扩展的仿真到现实移动操作迁移。我们进一步证明了多种互补监督形式在VLA训练中有效利用仿真资源的价值。

title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
summary: Shortcut learning is a prevalent issue in robot learning. The limited diversity of robot demonstration datasets can mislead policies into exploiting spurious correlations between tasks and irrelevant features, such as viewpoint or background. Collecting sufficiently diverse robot demonstrations is costly and inefficient, motivating algorithmic alternatives. We focus on vision-language-action (VLA) models and discover that different vision-language model backbones exhibit substantially different levels of susceptibility to visual shortcut learning. We find that model behavior correlates with our proposed representation-level metric, action margin, which requires no policy rollouts. Visual shortcuts consistently enter action representations in early layers, with models differing in the extent to which later layers correct them by incorporating language information. To boost models' attention to language, we introduce task scrubbing, a new domain-adversarial training method that decreases models' likelihood of using visual shortcuts and improves VLAs' generalization. Experiments in both simulation and the real world across multiple VLAs and visual cues show that task scrubbing improves out-of-distribution robustness and often eliminates visual shortcut learning.
tldr: This paper identifies visual shortcut learning in VLA models, proposes an action margin metric to measure it without rollouts, and introduces a domain-adversarial 'task scrubbing' training method that improves out-of-distribution robustness and reduces shortcut reliance in simulated and real robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文发现VLA模型中的视觉捷径学习问题，提出无需 rollout 的动作裕度指标进行度量，并引入任务擦除的域对抗训练方法，在仿真和真实机器人实验中改善分布外鲁棒性并减少捷径依赖。
summary_zh: 捷径学习是机器人学习中的一个普遍问题。机器人示范数据集多样性的局限可能误导策略，使其利用任务与无关特征（如视角或背景）之间的虚假相关性。收集足够多样化的机器人示范数据成本高昂且效率低下，因此亟需算法层面的替代方案。我们聚焦于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，并发现不同的视觉-语言模型骨干网络在易受视觉捷径学习影响方面存在显著差异。我们发现模型行为与我们提出的表征层面指标——动作边际（action margin）相关，该指标无需策略 rollout。视觉捷径始终在早期层进入动作表征，而不同模型在通过融入语言信息于后续层进行修正的程度方面存在差异。为增强模型对语言的关注，我们引入了任务擦除（task scrubbing），一种新的领域对抗训练方法，可降低模型利用视觉捷径的可能性并提升VLA的泛化能力。在仿真和真实世界的实验中，跨越多种VLA和视觉线索，任务擦除均能提升分布外鲁棒性，并常常消除视觉捷径学习现象。

title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
summary: The diversity of robot embodiments and action spaces makes it challenging to build robot world models that generalize across different embodiments. We introduce the Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model (LAC-WM), which operates within a learned unified latent action space shared across diverse embodiments. This unified action space improves the world model's performance when adapted to previously unseen robot embodiments. We compare LAC-WM with an Explicit Action-Conditioned World Model (EAC-WM), which conditions on explicit motion labels. Our results show that explicit action conditioning leads to disjoint action representations across embodiments, limiting downstream performance when adapting to new robots. We evaluate both models on dexterous manipulation tasks and a modified LIBERO benchmark. LAC-WM improves downstream performance over EAC-WM by up to 46.7% on dexterous manipulation and 11.7% on LIBERO. Crucially, the unified latent action space allows LAC-WM's downstream performance to scale positively with the number of embodiments used during pretraining. In contrast, the disjoint action space in EAC-WM leads to decreased performance as the number of pretraining embodiments increases. These results highlight the importance of a unified action space for efficient cross-embodiment learning, addressing a key challenge in robotics. Project website: https://lacwm.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces LAC-WM, a world model that learns a unified latent action space across robot embodiments, improving cross-embodiment generalization and downstream task performance compared to explicit action conditioning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 LAC-WM，一种在多种机器人形态间学习统一潜在动作空间的世界模型，相比显式动作条件化，提高了跨形态泛化能力和下游任务性能。
summary_zh: 机器人形态和动作空间的多样性使得构建能够跨不同形态泛化的机器人世界模型充满挑战。我们引入了潜在动作条件化机器人世界模型（LAC-WM），该模型在一个跨多种形态共享的学习到的统一潜在动作空间内运行。这一统一动作空间提升了世界模型在适应先前未见过的机器人形态时的性能。我们将LAC-WM与显式动作条件化世界模型（EAC-WM）进行了比较，后者依赖于显式运动标签进行条件化。结果表明，显式动作条件化会导致不同形态间的动作表示不连贯，从而限制了模型在适应新机器人时的下游性能。我们在灵巧操作任务和修改后的LIBERO基准上对这两种模型进行了评估。与EAC-WM相比，LAC-WM在灵巧操作任务上的下游性能提升了高达46.7%，在LIBERO基准上提升了11.7%。关键在于，统一的潜在动作空间使得LAC-WM的下游性能能够随着预训练期间使用的形态数量增加而正向扩展。相比之下，EAC-WM中不连贯的动作空间则导致预训练形态数量增加时性能下降。这些结果凸显了统一动作空间对于高效跨形态学习的重要性，解决了机器人学中的一个关键挑战。项目网站：https://lacwm.github.io/

title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
summary: Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 74.51 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 78.19 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.
tldr: NavGPT-3 is a hierarchical runtime that orchestrates a long-horizon reasoning LLM with a fast VLA action policy for vision-and-language navigation, achieving state-of-the-art results and human-level performance on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
tldr_zh: NavGPT-3 是一种分层运行时，协调长视界推理 LLM 与快速 VLA 动作策略，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上达到最先进水平及人类级性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：
经过长视界智能体强化学习训练的语言模型，能够通过推理泛化知识、表达精确动作，并在多步操作中追求目标，从而提升了具身智能体在理解与决策方面的上限。然而，物理交互仍属于动作策略的范畴，这类策略提供密集且低延迟的控制。我们提出了NavGPT-3，一种将两类模型连接起来的框架，并在此基础上构建了类操作系统的运行时环境：推理、动作执行与监控以线程形式运行，各自拥有独立的上下文、工具与权限，运行时负责调度这些线程，并决定由哪一个线程控制机器人的运动，从而使机器人能够通过中断和线程切换对突发的真实世界事件作出响应。在其底层，我们的动作策略NavGPT VLA在1928万条样本上训练而成，利用编解码器分配机制按场景变化比例分配视觉令牌；仅其8B模型在R2R-CE上就达到了74.51的成功率（SR），并在RxR-CE上以78.19的SR领先。借助完整的框架，NavGPT-3在R2R-CE上取得了当前最优成绩（81.51 SR），并首次将自主智能体提升至人类水平：在RxR-CE上，它以平均每幕1分22秒的用时在成功率（90.43 vs. 90.4 SR）和路径保真度（78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW）上匹配了人类跟随者，而人类平均耗时约3分钟。我们对框架设计及两类模型之间的交互进行了全面的消融实验，展示了工具与动作策略如何塑造从语言模型推理到物理控制的路径：当NavGPT VLA执行路线时，推理循环缩短，系统的最短反应时间从语言模型每次决策的3至19秒降至动作策略每步的0.5至1秒（1至2赫兹）。这些结果表明，设计这种具身接口对于连接前沿语言模型智能与底层物理控制至关重要。我们将公开所有模型、代码及评估记录。

title: BridgeGuard: Explicit Safety Drift for Diffusion-based Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion-based driving planners capture diverse behaviors but can generate unsafe trajectories under distribution shift. We propose BridgeGuard, a safety-constrained diffusion planning method that progressively strengthens a constraint term during denoising to drive intermediate trajectories toward a scene-dependent safety domain. Corrections operate in a low-dimensional curve space, promoting geometric coherence. A learned module, DistanceFieldNet, predicts a time-dependent distance field from bird's-eye-view features. Value and spatial-gradient supervision at queries sampled beyond expert trajectories teaches this field about both safe and unsafe regions. The learned field supplies the constraint term through safety injection while the pretrained perception backbone and planner remain frozen. We further establish sufficient conditions for terminal safety in an idealized continuous-time bridge. On Bench2Drive, BridgeGuard improves driving score/success rate from 87.99/74.99% to 90.88/76.36% for BridgeDrive and from 80.79/58.18% to 90.46/74.09% for $\text{DiffusionDrive}^{\text{geo}}$, demonstrating cross-model generalization.
tldr: BridgeGuard enhances diffusion-based autonomous driving planners by introducing an explicit safety drift term during denoising, guided by a learned time-dependent distance field, improving safety and success rates on Bench2Drive.
tldr_zh: BridgeGuard 通过在去噪过程中引入显式安全漂移项，并由学习的时间相关距离场引导，增强了基于扩散的自动驾驶规划器的安全性，在 Bench2Drive 上提高了安全性和成功率。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的驾驶规划器能够捕捉多样化的驾驶行为，但在分布偏移情况下可能生成不安全的轨迹。我们提出BridgeGuard，一种安全约束的扩散规划方法，在去噪过程中逐步增强约束项，将中间轨迹引导至场景相关的安全域。校正操作在低维曲线空间中进行，以促进几何一致性。我们设计了一个学习模块DistanceFieldNet，从鸟瞰图特征中预测时间相关的距离场。在专家轨迹之外采样查询点，并施加数值与空间梯度监督，使该距离场同时学习安全区域与不安全区域。该学习到的距离场通过安全注入提供约束项，而预训练的感知主干与规划器保持冻结。我们进一步在理想化的连续时间桥接过程中建立了终端安全性的充分条件。在Bench2Drive基准上，BridgeGuard将驾驶得分/成功率从87.99/74.99%提升至90.88/76.36%（针对BridgeDrive），并将80.79/58.18%提升至90.46/74.09%（针对$\text{DiffusionDrive}^{\text{geo}}$），展示了跨模型的泛化能力。

title: AffordDrive3D: Affordance-Aware World-Action Modeling with Spatial Understanding
summary: World-action models have recently improved autonomous driving by jointly learning future scene prediction and trajectory generation. Most existing approaches model the future primarily through RGB appearance, and recent works have begun to incorporate geometric prediction to improve spatial understanding. However, dense geometry describes the spatial layout of the entire scene without indicating which parts are most relevant to the ego vehicle's action. For driving, the model must also identify and anticipate where it can safely move and which regions may pose collision risks. Jointly modeling action-relevant regions and future geometry can provide the policy with both driving-relevant cues and their corresponding spatial structure. We therefore propose AffordDrive3D, an affordance- and geometry-aware world-action model that jointly learns future action-relevant regions and spatial structure. In order to capture the scene semantics and driving context needed for driving affordance prediction, we build AffordDrive3D on a VLM backbone to forecast drivable areas and collision-critical regions that directly affect ego motion, while predicting future geometry from RGB world-model latents. On NAVSIM, AffordDrive3D achieves state-of-the-art performance with 91.3 PDMS and 89.9 EPDMS, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling future affordances and geometry for trajectory planning.
tldr: AffordDrive3D is an affordance- and geometry-aware world-action model for autonomous driving that jointly predicts future action-relevant regions (drivable areas and collision-critical regions) and future geometry from RGB latents, achieving SOTA performance on NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: AffordDrive3D是一个用于自动驾驶的、结合可供性和几何感知的世界动作模型，它联合预测未来的动作相关区域（可行驶区域和碰撞关键区域）以及来自RGB潜在表征的未来几何结构，在NAVSIM上实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型近期通过联合学习未来场景预测与轨迹生成，提升了自动驾驶性能。现有方法大多主要通过RGB外观建模未来，而近期工作开始引入几何预测以增强空间理解。然而，稠密几何描述了整个场景的空间布局，却未指明哪些部分与自车动作最为相关。对于驾驶任务而言，模型还需识别并预判其可安全行驶的区域以及可能存在碰撞风险的区域。联合建模动作相关区域与未来几何，能够为策略提供驾驶相关线索及其对应的空间结构。为此，我们提出AffordDrive3D——一种融合可通行区域与几何感知的世界动作模型，联合学习未来动作相关区域及空间结构。为捕捉驾驶可通行区域预测所需的场景语义与驾驶情境，我们基于VLM骨干构建AffordDrive3D，以预测直接影响自车运动的可行驶区域和碰撞关键区域，同时从RGB世界模型潜变量中预测未来几何。在NAVSIM基准上，AffordDrive3D取得了91.3 PDMS和89.9 EPDMS的最优性能，验证了联合建模未来可通行区域与几何结构对轨迹规划的有效性。

title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
summary: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.
tldr: Dex-One2Many learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video by abstracting it into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration and broad generalization across object poses and grasps, with zero-shot transfer to a real multi-fingered hand.
tldr_zh: Dex-One2Many 通过将单个人类视频抽象为顺序场景图来指导强化学习，从单个视频中学习可泛化的灵巧操作策略，实现高效探索和跨物体位姿与抓取的广泛泛化，并零样本迁移到真实多指手。
summary_zh: 从单个人类视频中学习灵巧操作，为昂贵的机器人示教提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但近期许多方法主要模仿所演示的运动。这种严格的运动匹配往往限制了对视频中未出现的初始物体位姿、目标位姿及抓取方式的泛化能力。相比之下，通过强化学习（RL）发现策略虽然能够实现广泛泛化，但在缺乏先验引导的情况下，其在高维探索空间中应对复杂的多阶段任务时存在困难。为解决这些泛化与探索相耦合的挑战，我们提出了Dex-One2Many，一种从单个人类视频中学习可泛化灵巧操作策略的真实-仿真-真实框架。我们的关键见解在于，将视频抽象为顺序场景图以引导强化学习，从而在保持广泛泛化能力的同时实现高效探索。这些场景图作为生成式约束，用于采样多样化的重置状态，并为每个阶段提供稠密奖励。由于场景图约束的是关系而非精确位姿，这些重置状态覆盖了视频之外的物体位姿和抓取方式，同时从这些状态初始化每个阶段并辅以稠密奖励，使得探索过程保持短小而具有引导性。Dex-One2Many完全在仿真中训练，可零样本迁移到真实的多指手上。在五项工具使用和操作任务中，Dex-One2Many在可见配置下超过基线方法6.5%，而其在未见场景中的强大泛化能力则将该差距扩大至71%。

title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
summary: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. Training such a model on existing robot datasets faces two obstacles: imprecise calibration can impair action following, while limited coverage of unsuccessful interactions can bias predictions toward successful outcomes. To improve action following across embodiments, we render action trajectories into image-space conditions and introduce offline geometric calibration to align these conditions with the target videos. To broaden interaction coverage, we introduce counterfactual post-training, modifying recorded action trajectories and generating future videos under a wider range of actions and contact configurations. To provide feedback on these predictions without paired ground-truth futures, we construct a human-annotated video dataset covering robot, object, and interaction defects and use it to train an embodied video reward model. Its scores guide reinforcement-learning post-training toward more physically plausible interaction outcomes. On AgiBot, DreamTrue attains state-of-the-art action following, while reducing the human-assessed interaction defect rate from from 48.12% to 6.25%. Notably, our model ranks first in the world model track of the AgiBot World Challenge 2026. The project page can be found at https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue.
tldr: DreamTrue is a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model featuring counterfactual post-training and offline geometric calibration to improve action faithfulness and physical plausibility of video prediction, achieving state-of-the-art results in the AgiBot World Challenge.
tldr_zh: DreamTrue是一种多视角、跨本体的机器人世界模型，通过反事实后训练和离线几何校准来增强动作忠实度和物理合理性，在AgiBot世界挑战赛中取得最优结果。
summary_zh: 我们提出了DreamTrue，一种多视角、跨本体的机器人世界模型，用于动作忠实且物理上合理的视频预测。在现有机器人数据集上训练此类模型面临两大障碍：不精确的标定会损害动作跟随能力，而失败交互样本覆盖不足会使预测偏向于成功结果。为提升跨本体的动作跟随能力，我们将动作轨迹渲染为图像空间条件，并引入离线几何标定以将这些条件与目标视频对齐。为拓宽交互覆盖范围，我们引入了反事实后训练，通过修改记录的动作轨迹并在更广泛的动作与接触配置下生成未来视频。为在没有配对真值未来的情况下对这些预测提供反馈，我们构建了一个覆盖机器人、物体及交互缺陷的人工标注视频数据集，并利用其训练一个具身视频奖励模型。该模型的评分引导强化学习后训练趋向更物理合理的交互结果。在AgiBot上，DreamTrue达到了最先进的动作跟随性能，同时将人工评估的交互缺陷率从48.12%降至6.25%。值得注意的是，我们的模型在AgiBot World Challenge 2026世界模型赛道中排名第一。项目页面可在https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue获取。

title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
summary: Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. Existing safeguards either inspect the prompt, require labeled motion data, or enforce geometric constraints; therefore, they do not directly account for how scene context changes a motion's meaning. We introduce contextual safety filtering (CSF), a training-free filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories produced by the generator. For each active rule, safe and unsafe reference trajectories define an affine safety value that a safe reference tracking CBF-QP enforces. Across four pretrained generators with different architectures, CSF activates the intended rules in all explicit and scene-triggered unsafe cases and reduces the danger-event rate by up to 90%, while preserving 88-100% of benign motions. We demonstrate the complete system on a real-world Unitree G1, where it successfully prevents unsafe motions in a variety of scenarios, including interactions with humans and objects.
tldr: This paper introduces a training-free contextual safety filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories for text-conditioned motion generators, enforcing safety via a CBF-QP and demonstrating reduced danger events on real Unitree G1 robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种无需训练的上下文安全滤波器，将自然语言安全规则与安全/不安全参考轨迹关联，通过CBF-QP强制执行安全，并在真实Unitree G1机器人上降低危险事件率。
summary_zh: 文本条件运动生成器能够生成可追踪的全身运动，但其缺乏对场景相关安全性的认知：同一动作可能针对物体或人。现有的安全防护手段要么检查提示词，要么需要标注运动数据，要么强制施加几何约束；因此，它们并未直接考虑场景上下文如何改变运动的意义。我们提出了上下文安全过滤（CSF），这是一种无需训练的过滤器，它将自然语言安全规则锚定在生成器产生的安全与不安全参考轨迹上。对于每条生效的规则，安全与不安全的参考轨迹定义了一个仿射安全值，由安全参考跟踪CBF-QP强制执行。在四个不同架构的预训练生成器上，CSF在所有显式及场景触发的危险情形中均能激活预期规则，并将危险事件发生率降低高达90%，同时保留88%至100%的安全运动。我们在真实世界的宇树G1机器人上展示了完整系统，该系统在包括与人类和物体交互在内的多种场景中均能成功防止危险运动的发生。

title: SpatialHarness: Test-Time Spatial Scaffolding for Fine Robotic Manipulation
summary: Frontier multimodal foundation models (e.g., GPT-6 Astra) have recently shown strong potential for direct robotic control, yet their performance on fine manipulation remains limited. We argue that an important source of failure is not necessarily insufficient policy capability, but insufficient spatial observability, where task-critical spatial relationships may be poorly revealed by the existing physical camera setup. We introduce SpatialHarness, a test-time embodied harness that provides test-time spatial scaffolding for fine robotic manipulation without policy fine-tuning or changes to the physical sensing setup. SpatialHarness maintains an online simulated scene synchronized with real-world execution, identifies task-critical spatial relationships, and renders complementary virtual views that expose them to a frozen multimodal policy. To keep the simulated scene aligned during interaction, we develop interaction-aware scene synchronization that distinguishes static, held, and transition modes. We evaluate SpatialHarness on four real-robot manipulation tasks spanning precise geometric alignment, object-relative placement, and articulated-object interaction. Using the same frozen GPT-6 Astra policy, SpatialHarness substantially improves task success, including from 26.7% to 66.7% on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on Tower of Hanoi. These results indicate that improving spatial observability at test time can unlock fine-manipulation capabilities already present in strong multimodal foundation models. Project website: https://emilia113.github.io/SpatialHarness/.
tldr: SpatialHarness introduces a test-time embodied system that maintains an online simulated scene synchronized with real robot execution, renders complementary virtual views to expose critical spatial relationships to a frozen multimodal policy, and significantly improves fine manipulation success without policy fine-tuning or physical camera changes.
tldr_zh: SpatialHarness 提出了一种测试时具身框架，通过在线模拟场景与真实执行同步，渲染补充虚拟视角向冻结的多模态策略提供关键空间关系，从而在不微调策略或改变物理相机的情况下显著提升精细操作成功率。
summary_zh: 前沿多模态基础模型（如GPT-6 Astra）近来展现出直接进行机器人控制的巨大潜力，然而其在精细操作任务上的表现仍然有限。我们认为，失败的一个重要根源未必是策略能力不足，而是空间可观测性不足——在现有物理相机布置下，任务关键的空间关系可能难以被充分揭示。我们提出SpatialHarness，一种测试时具身赋能框架，可在无需策略微调或改动物理传感布局的前提下，为精细机器人操作提供测试时的空间脚手架支持。SpatialHarness维护一个与真实世界执行同步的在线仿真场景，识别任务关键的空间关系，并渲染互补的虚拟视角，将这些关系暴露给冻结的多模态策略。为了在交互过程中保持仿真场景的对齐，我们开发了交互感知的场景同步机制，区分静态、持握和过渡三种模式。我们在四个真实机器人操作任务上评估了SpatialHarness，涵盖精确几何对齐、物体相对放置以及关节物体交互。在使用同一冻结GPT-6 Astra策略的条件下，SpatialHarness显著提升了任务成功率，其中插头插入任务从26.7%提升至66.7%，汉诺塔任务从0%提升至100%。这些结果表明，在测试时提升空间可观测性能够释放强大多模态基础模型中已具备的精细操作能力。项目网站：https://emilia113.github.io/SpatialHarness/。

title: VersaCamVLA: Camera-Configurable VLA Policies for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful foundations for robotic manipulation, but their reliance on fixed camera configurations during training makes them brittle to changes in camera count or pose during deployment. To overcome these limitations, we propose VersaCamVLA, a camera-configurable framework that decouples camera-set representation from action learning. VersaCamVLA learns a unified scene-token interface that maps an arbitrary, variable set of posed RGB views into fixed-size latent scene tokens. This is achieved via multi-signal target-view prediction and Wrist-Augmented Pose Sampling (WAPS), which leverages natural wrist-camera motion for free pose diversity. At deployment, a lightweight spatial encoder injects these compact scene tokens into a pretrained base VLA as a supplementary visual condition, requiring no explicit 3D sensing or novel-view rendering. Experiments on RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real-robot platform demonstrate that VersaCamVLA consistently outperforms prior VLA methods and direct multi-view baselines, maintaining robust performance across varying camera counts and unseen camera poses.
tldr: VersaCamVLA introduces a camera-configurable VLA framework that decouples camera-set representation from action learning via a unified scene-token interface, enabling robust performance across varying camera counts and unseen poses in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: VersaCamVLA 提出了一种相机可配置的 VLA 框架，通过统一的场景令牌接口将相机集合表示与动作学习解耦，从而在机器人操作中实现跨相机数量和未见姿态的鲁棒性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人操作任务中的强大基础框架，但其在训练过程中依赖于固定的相机配置，导致在部署阶段面对相机数量或位姿变化时表现脆弱。为克服上述局限，我们提出VersaCamVLA——一种相机可配置框架，将相机集合表示与动作学习解耦。VersaCamVLA学习了一个统一的场景令牌接口，可将任意、可变数量的带位姿RGB视角映射为固定大小的潜在场景令牌。该接口通过多信号目标视角预测以及腕部增强位姿采样（WAPS）实现，后者利用自然腕部相机运动以提供免费的位姿多样性。在部署阶段，一个轻量级空间编码器将这些紧凑的场景令牌作为补充视觉条件注入预训练的基础VLA中，无需显式三维感知或新视角渲染。在RoboTwin、LIBERO及真实机器人平台上的实验表明，VersaCamVLA在相机数量变化及未见相机位姿条件下均持续优于现有VLA方法及直接多视角基线方法，展现出稳健的性能表现。

title: Generative Neural Retargeting for Human-to-Robot Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning dexterous manipulation, but the embodiment gap prevents human motion from being executed directly on robots. Inverse kinematics (IK) retargets human motion to robots efficiently but ignores dynamics, often producing infeasible motions. Reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) are commonly employed to yield dynamically feasible motions, but both are sample-inefficient and sensitive to hyperparameters. RL suffers from costly and unstable training and tedious reward engineering; MPC avoids policy optimization, yet retargets each trajectory in isolation, and solving one does not make the next easier. Sampling cost grows rapidly with dataset size and task difficulty. We hypothesize that dynamically feasible trajectories concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold shared across demonstrations, so that retargeting can be reduced to sampling from that manifold, conditioned on human motion, rather than solving a fresh optimization problem for every demonstration. We propose \textbf{Generative Neural Retargeting} (GNR), which uses a flow matching model to sample feasible trajectories. GNR outperforms MPC with only $8.5\%$ of the samples required by MPC, achieving a success rate of $56.20\%$ compared to $27.20\%$ for MPC. GNR can be used for scalable and efficient retargeting of large-scale, long-horizon, and millimeter precision human demonstrations: by applying GNR within a real-to-sim data engine, we produce a dexterous manipulation dataset with dense contact-force labels, spanning $223$k demonstrations and $3.3$k object geometries.
tldr: This paper proposes Generative Neural Retargeting (GNR), a flow matching model that samples dynamically feasible robot trajectories conditioned on human demonstrations, replacing inefficient MPC/RL for human-to-robot dexterous manipulation retargeting, and enabling large-scale dataset generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出生成式神经重定向（GNR），利用流匹配模型基于人类演示采样机器人动态可行轨迹，替代低效的MPC/RL，用于灵巧操作重定向，并支持大规模数据集生成。
summary_zh: 人类示范是学习灵巧操作的可扩展数据来源，但本体差异使得人类动作无法直接在机器人上执行。逆运动学（IK）能够高效地将人类动作重定向到机器人，但忽略了动力学特性，常常产生不可行的运动。强化学习（RL）和基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）通常用于生成动力学上可行的运动，但两者都存在样本效率低和对超参数敏感的问题。RL面临训练成本高、训练不稳定以及奖励工程繁琐等挑战；MPC则避免了策略优化，但对每条轨迹单独进行重定向，解决一条轨迹并不会使下一条变得更容易。采样成本随数据集规模和任务难度的增加而快速增长。我们假设动力学上可行的轨迹集中在跨示范共享的低维流形附近，因此可以将重定向问题简化为在该流形上以人类运动为条件进行采样，而不是为每条示范重新求解优化问题。我们提出**生成式神经重定向**（GNR），该方法使用流匹配模型来采样可行轨迹。GNR仅需MPC所需样本的$8.5\%$即可超越MPC，成功率达到$56.20\%$，而MPC为$27.20\%$。GNR可用于大规模、长时域、毫米级精度人类示范的可扩展高效重定向：通过在真实到仿真数据引擎中应用GNR，我们生成了一个包含密集接触力标签的灵巧操作数据集，涵盖$223$k条示范和$3.3$k种物体几何形状。

title: FAITH: Feasibility-Aware Safety-Filtered RL for High-Dimensional Systems
summary: Safe reinforcement learning commonly places safety and task performance in the same policy objective, where they can introduce competing updates. Safety filters separate them at action execution, but classical designs require an analytic safety function and dynamics model, and standard minimal-intervention filters are myopic to long-horizon task return because they minimize only instantaneous action deviation. Hard projections are also undefined when no safe action exists. We present FAITH, a feasibility-aware, model-free framework that approximates the optimal state-action safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering with a feedforward network. The task policy optimizes the task return through the filtered dynamics, which recovers the feasible constrained problem without a competing safety term in the task-policy update. When no action satisfies the learned safety condition, the same filter approaches the action with minimum predicted peak harm. On a double integrator example and a Safety Gym environment, FAITH achieves the highest return among methods with no feasible-start violations and matches the lowest harm from infeasible starts. On a 29-DoF humanoid, it reaches a 99.95% safety rate while retaining 97% of the unfiltered return in Walking-Avoid, and obtains the highest measured safety rate in Push-Avoid by learning to sacrifice balancing and fall away from the protected region. The same policies are also demonstrated on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid.
tldr: FAITH proposes a feasibility-aware, model-free safety filter for safe RL that approximates optimal safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering via a feedforward network, achieving high safety and return in high-dimensional simulated and real humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: FAITH 提出了一种可行感知、无模型的强化学习安全过滤器，通过前馈网络近似最优安全值并摊销最小干预滤波，在仿真和真实人形机器人上实现了高安全性和高回报。
summary_zh: 安全强化学习通常将安全性与任务性能置于同一策略目标中，这可能引入相互竞争的更新。安全过滤器在动作执行阶段将二者分离，但经典设计需要解析的安全函数和动力学模型，且标准的最小干预过滤器仅最小化瞬时动作偏差，对长期任务回报具有短视性。当不存在安全动作时，硬投影也无法定义。我们提出FAITH，一种可行性感知、无模型的框架，它近似最优状态-动作安全值，并通过前馈网络摊销最小干预过滤。任务策略通过过滤后的动力学优化任务回报，从而在任务策略更新中无需竞争性安全项即可恢复可行的约束问题。当没有动作满足学习到的安全条件时，同一过滤器将趋近于预测峰值危害最小的动作。在双积分器示例和Safety Gym环境中，FAITH在无可行起始违规的方法中取得了最高回报，并匹配了不可行起始下的最低危害。在29自由度人形机器人上，FAITH在Walking-Avoid中达到了99.95%的安全率，同时保留了未过滤回报的97%，并在Push-Avoid中通过学会牺牲平衡、远离受保护区域摔倒而获得了最高的实测安全率。相同策略也已在真实世界的Unitree G1人形机器人上得到验证。

title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
summary: A generalist robot should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input--output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis, and the validated release of new skills, while people steer the process through objectives and corrections; stable skill sequences are further consolidated into reusable compound skills. On a mobile manipulator, RoboRSI develops multi-object household cleanup over 104 rounds. In simulation, it achieves the highest success rate on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points.
tldr: RoboRSI introduces Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR), a self-improvement system that decomposes tasks into hierarchical skills, attributes execution outcomes to responsible branches, and validates skill release, enabling a mobile manipulator to improve over 104 rounds and surpass baselines in simulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RoboRSI 提出了自上而下的技能细化（TSR），该自改进系统将任务分解为分层技能，将执行结果归因于相应分支并验证技能发布，使移动操作机器人在104轮迭代中提升性能，并在模拟基准上超越基线。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人不仅应能执行多种任务，更应能从经验中持续改进，将执行过程中所学转化为可供后续任务复用的能力。基于代码行动的智能体已能依据执行反馈修复程序，但如何将经验围绕赋予其意义的任务结构进行组织，使每次修复归因于相应能力、获得执行证据支持，并在复用前经过验证，仍是核心挑战。为此，我们提出RoboRSI——一种基于自上而下技能精炼（Top-Down Skill Refinement, TSR）的机器人自我改进系统。TSR将任务分解为复合技能、原子技能和基础技能，明确各层级的职责范围及输入—输出契约，将每次执行结果归因于对应分支，并将修改限制在该分支内。在此基础上，管理者（Manager）、规划者（Planner）、工程师（Engineer）与评审者（Reviewer）协同完成规划、执行、诊断及新技能的可控发布，人类则通过目标和纠正意见引导整个过程；稳定的技能序列进一步整合为可复用的复合技能。在移动操作平台上，RoboRSI经过104轮迭代掌握了多目标家庭清洁任务。在仿真环境中，它在LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus及RoboTwin基准上均取得最高成功率，超出最强基线2.7至11.0个百分点。

title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.
tldr: LeWAM is a bidirectional transformer-based World Action Model trained on a JEPA latent that predicts actions and observations across multiple dynamics modes, and demonstrates that planning in noise space improves MPC closed-loop performance.
tldr_zh: LeWAM 是一个基于 JEPA 潜空间训练的双向 Transformer 世界动作模型，能够预测动作和观测，并展示了在噪声空间规划可提升 MPC 闭环性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过基于重构的表征来预测动作和未来观测，但这种表征包含噪声和冗余信息，可能使下游预测复杂化。我们提出LeWAM，一种用于前向、后向、逆动力学及策略预测的双向Transformer，其基于无解码器的JEPA潜变量，通过四种模式进行端到端训练。我们观察到以下优势：1）对齐性：线性探针从LeWAM的潜变量中读取机器人与物体状态的效果优于从常规Le World Model（一种仅前向的JEPA世界模型）中读取，同时其潜变量在忽略视觉干扰物方面与LeWM表现相当，且远优于基于重构的WAM。2）动作执行：在闭环评估中，LeWAM的性能与在相同编码器上训练的同等规模常规流匹配策略相当，同时额外提供世界模型能力。3）规划：使用WAMs进行规划时，直接采样原始动作会使模型预测控制（MPC）利用动力学模型的不准确性；而改为在策略头部的噪声空间中进行规划，则可提升这些WAMs的闭环性能。

title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.
tldr: This paper proposes Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP), a paradigm where robot control policies are written entirely in code that tracks explicit state from sensor data, eliminating the need for VLM/VLA in the loop and enabling recursive self-improvement. It demonstrates on 42 bimanual tasks, achieving 70.24% success without a model at test time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“仅代码策略”（COAP）的范式，其中机器人控制策略完全由代码编写，通过传感器数据跟踪显式状态，无需在回路中部署VLM/VLA，并支持递归自我改进。在42个双臂任务上，无需测试时模型即可实现70.24%的成功率。
summary_zh: 大多数机器人策略都在控制回路中保留一个模型：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）将观测映射为动作，而智能体框架（如Agent-as-Policy或Harness VLA）则在运行时查询视觉语言模型（VLM）进行决策。我们提出一种不同的视角：具身世界是一台具身图灵机，其纸带为机器人与环境状态，规则为策略。若该状态能被精确表示，则决策可完全以代码实现。因此，我们提出纯代码策略（Code-Only-as-Policy，COAP）：代码从相机图像和本体感觉中测量并跟踪机器人、环境及任务状态，并据此做出所有决策。同一代码跨回合适用，不同任务共享同一代码库，而无需在回路中引入VLM或VLA。与VLA和智能体框架相比，我们分析了COAP的三项优势：（i）显式状态：状态可存储于代码中；（ii）执行性：代码使决策可控，能从故障中灵活恢复，且在线运行快速廉价；（iii）可扩展性：新任务可复用、继承或扩展共享代码库，因此能力可随任务不断积累。这些优势使COAP成为递归自我改进（RSI）的合适媒介：编码智能体在闭环中开发代码库，且每次修改都显式可控。在RoboDojo的42个双臂任务中，所构建的代码库在测试时不使用任何模型即达到70.24%的成功率。COAP的上限取决于状态表示对决策的精确程度以及代码逻辑的鲁棒性。因此，我们提出COAP作为具身任务的新范式；由于它跨回合适用，它也可作为VLA和智能体框架的高效数据引擎。

title: PLaW-VLA: Predictive Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Learning to predict how the world evolves can provide vision-language-action (VLA) policies with predictive context for long-horizon control, but its effectiveness depends on what future representation is modeled and how it conditions action generation. We introduce PLaW-VLA, which models task-relevant future states in a pretrained prediction-oriented representation space, reducing the need to predict control-irrelevant visual details. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, PLaW-VLA conditions action generation on observation history, current task semantics, and predicted future states through structured causal attention. Experiments show a +11.8 percentage-point (pp) gain over reactive policies on RoboTwin Hard Horizon III and a +1.77 pp gain over reconstruction-oriented latent prediction on zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, supporting improved long-horizon control and generalization under distribution shift, respectively. By avoiding low-level visual reconstruction, PLaW-VLA lowers the burden of future prediction, enabling a lightweight latent world model with parallel future prediction and about 1/19 the inference latency of generative world-action modeling at comparable policy performance.
tldr: PLaW-VLA introduces a predictive latent world model for VLA policies, predicting task-relevant future states in a pretrained representation space to improve long-horizon control and generalization with reduced latency.
tldr_zh: PLaW-VLA 为视觉-语言-动作策略引入了预测性潜在世界模型，通过预测任务相关的未来状态来提升长期控制和泛化能力，同时降低推理延迟。
summary_zh: 学习预测世界如何演变能够为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供面向长时程控制的预测性上下文，但其效果取决于建模何种未来表征以及该表征如何调控动作生成。我们提出PLaW-VLA，在预训练的面向预测的表征空间中建模与任务相关的未来状态，从而减少对与控制无关的视觉细节的预测需求。基于混合Transformer架构，PLaW-VLA通过结构化因果注意力机制，将动作生成条件建立在观测历史、当前任务语义及预测未来状态之上。实验表明，在RoboTwin Hard Horizon III任务上，PLaW-VLA相较于反应式策略提升了11.8个百分点（pp）；在零样本LIBERO-Plus任务上，相较于面向重建的潜在预测方法提升了1.77个百分点（pp），分别验证了其在长时程控制改善和分布偏移下泛化能力方面的优势。通过避免底层视觉重建，PLaW-VLA降低了未来预测的负担，使得轻量级潜在世界模型能够实现并行未来预测，并在策略性能相当的情况下，推理延迟约为生成式世界-动作建模方法的1/19。

title: MiniWAM: Learning Compact Future Targets for Efficient World-Action Modeling
summary: World modeling has emerged as an effective co-training objective for robot policies, giving rise to World Action Models (WAMs) that jointly predict actions and future states. However, most WAMs predict future states in the native representation space of pretrained visual backbones, resulting in high-dimensional targets with substantial training cost. We introduce MiniWAM, which instead predicts compact future representations learned from privileged current-future transitions. To construct these targets, we propose Predictive Representations via Inverse Spatiotemporal Modeling (PRISM), which combines inverse-dynamics supervision with feature reconstruction to emphasize control-relevant transition information while preserving useful future-state information. With the learned PRISM encoder frozen, MiniWAM is trained to jointly predict the resulting targets and robot actions from current observations. With 65$\times$ fewer native future feature tokens, MiniWAM consistently outperforms native future-feature prediction with both DINOv3 and WAN2.1 VAE features, while achieving up to an 8$\times$ speedup in world-action training. At 0.25B parameters, MiniWAM is already competitive with substantially larger WAMs on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmarks. Representation analyses further show that PRISM contributes behavioral structure beyond feature reconstruction alone. These results demonstrate that effective world-action modeling does not require predicting native visual futures, and that compact predictive representations provide a strong and substantially more efficient target for policy learning. The project page is available at: https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM.
tldr: MiniWAM introduces compact future representations learned via inverse-dynamics and feature reconstruction, enabling more efficient and effective world-action modeling for robot policies.
tldr_zh: MiniWAM 通过逆动力学和特征重建学习紧凑的未来表示，从而更高效、更有效地进行机器人策略的世界-动作建模。
summary_zh: 世界建模已成为机器人策略的一种有效协同训练目标，催生了能够联合预测动作与未来状态的“世界动作模型”（WAMs）。然而，大多数WAMs在预训练视觉骨干网络的原始表示空间中预测未来状态，导致高维目标及高昂的训练成本。我们提出了MiniWAM，它转而预测从特权当前-未来转移中学习到的紧凑未来表示。为构建这些目标，我们提出了“基于逆时空建模的预测表示”（PRISM），该方法将逆动力学监督与特征重建相结合，以强调与控制相关的转移信息，同时保留有用的未来状态信息。在冻结学习到的PRISM编码器后，MiniWAM被训练为从当前观测联合预测所得目标与机器人动作。凭借比原生未来特征令牌少65倍的规模，MiniWAM在使用DINOv3和WAN2.1 VAE特征时均持续优于原生未来特征预测，同时在世界动作训练中实现了最高8倍的加速。在0.25B参数规模下，MiniWAM在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准上已能与规模大得多的WAMs相抗衡。表示分析进一步表明，PRISM带来了超越单纯特征重建的行为结构。这些结果表明，有效的世界动作建模并不需要预测原生视觉未来，紧凑的预测表示为策略学习提供了强有力且效率显著更高的目标。项目页面见：https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM。

title: RESETTLE: Robotic Recovery through Disagreement-Triggered Retrieval and Efficient Corrective Control
summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires timely intervention to correct emerging deviations and restore progress after execution errors. However, recovery methods based on repeated vision-language reasoning or iterative online optimization can incur substantial latency, delaying intervention. To address these challenges, we introduce RESETTLE(Robotic rEcovery through diSagrEement-Triggered reTrievaL and Efficient Corrective Control), a model-agnostic framework that provides computationally efficient recovery at the action-execution interface of frozen robot policies. RESETTLE triggers recovery when two action proposals independently sampled under identical conditioning persistently disagree. It retrieves a same-task demonstration reference using an adapted V-JEPA encoder and combines a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual to execute one corrective action without online trajectory optimization or additional vision-language reasoning, then returns control to the base policy. Across six base policies in simulation, RESETTLE achieves up to 8.70%, 6.28%, and 6.83% absolute success-rate gains on LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World, and RoboCasa Tabletop, respectively, with further improvements on four real-world tasks using two policies. In QwenPI-based comparisons, its monitoring-and-recovery computation latency is 74.04%--93.57% lower than VoLoAgent's monitoring-and-planning latency for grasp and place tool calls. It also raises Harness VLA's LIBERO-Pro Swap success from 42% to 50%, demonstrating compatibility with high-level agentic planning. Code available at: https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE
tldr: RESETTLE is a model-agnostic framework that triggers recovery in frozen robot policies via disagreement between sampled action proposals, retrieves a demonstration reference with a V-JEPA encoder, and executes one corrective action using a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual, improving success rates across multiple benchmarks and real-world tasks without online optimization.
tldr_zh: RESETTLE 是一个模型无关的框架，通过采样动作提案之间的分歧触发恢复，使用 V-JEPA 编码器检索演示参考，并结合状态伺服先验与受保护的视觉残差执行一次纠正动作，无需在线优化即可在多个基准和真实任务中提升成功率。
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人操作需要及时干预，以纠正出现的偏差并在执行错误后恢复进度。然而，基于重复的视觉-语言推理或迭代在线优化的恢复方法可能产生显著的延迟，从而推迟干预。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了RESETTLE（通过分歧触发检索与高效纠正控制的机器人恢复框架），这是一个模型无关的框架，在冻结机器人策略的动作执行接口处提供计算高效的恢复。当两个在相同条件下独立采样的动作提案持续出现分歧时，RESETTLE会触发恢复。它利用适配的V-JEPA编码器检索同任务演示参考，并将状态伺服先验与受保护的视觉残差相结合，执行一次纠正动作，无需在线轨迹优化或额外的视觉-语言推理，随后将控制权交还给基础策略。在仿真环境中，跨六种基础策略，RESETTLE在LIBERO-Plus、Meta-World和RoboCasa Tabletop上分别实现了最高8.70%、6.28%和6.83%的绝对成功率提升，并在四个真实世界任务中借助两种策略获得了进一步改进。在与QwenPI的对比中，其监控与恢复计算延迟比VoLoAgent的监控与规划延迟低74.04%--93.57%，适用于抓取和放置工具调用。此外，RESETTLE将Harness VLA在LIBERO-Pro Swap上的成功率从42%提升至50%，展示了其与高层智能体规划的兼容性。代码已开源：https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE

title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
summary: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation.
